notes.title: Update on the Development of Kokopa's Atlas: A Message from Junie
notes.content:
Greetings Kokopa's Atlas community,

I wanted to take a moment to update you on the status of the game's development. Unfortunately, we have hit unexpected obstacles that have caused a delay in the project. I want to reassure you that we are not giving up on the game. Instead, we are taking a pause in development to focus on making important internal improvements that will result in the best gaming experience possible. 
Additionally, I wanted to let you know that Aesthetican Labs, who has been shepherding the product and community since last Spring, is no longer working on the project. We thank them for their excellent work and wish them well in their future endeavors. We want to let you know that we are still fully dedicated to making Kokopa's Atlas the game you've been waiting for, and our team is working hard to ensure that the final product will exceed your expectations.

I want to address that the delay has not yet been announced on Kickstarter, but we intend to do so as soon as we fix some technical issues with our account settings. Please bear with us as we work to resolve these issues.

Your patience and support mean everything to us, and we appreciate your understanding during this time. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on the Hitcents Discord server.

Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for future updates.

Best regards,

Junie (Dasher)

notes.title: A Happy Holiday Update! ❄️
notes.content:
Hey there, Atlasers! 😄

With the holidays rapidly approaching, it sure is a chaotic time of year! Here’s what we can share about what we’ve been up to since November’s update: 

Probably the most exciting thing: we’ve added side quests! 

https://i.imgur.com/OCo7BGg.png

On top of the main quest line (which we talked a bit about in November), there will now be side quests from the other folks you meet. This could include getting them things from the nearby forest, doing a bit of gardening for them, and more! 

Specifically, in implementing side quests, we ran into a few major development issues that slowed us down. So we spent quite a bit of time trying to iron those out (and it’s still not quite over!). 

We’ve also made some performance improvements. 

https://i.imgur.com/JyAY5VR.png

The newest biome, the forest, has foliage that’s a lot more dense than the grasslands… and we needed to do some optimization so the game would run smoothly with so many objects in the world. 

Aside from those, it’s largely been about bug hunting! 

https://i.imgur.com/cx8A0uf.png

We call this style... chin glasses!

The end of the year is a busy time and many teams have deadlines to meet before the holidays… we’re no different in that regard. We’ve got goals to meet, and part of those goals means polishing as many rough edges as we can before we set things aside for the year. Perhaps not as exciting to read about, but SO important to how the game feels. 

Things will be pretty quiet around the Kokopa’s Atlas Discord over the holidays, more than likely, but you’re always welcome to join! And it’d be giving our team a real gift if you wishlist the game on Steam (presuming you haven’t already). 

From all the folks working on Kokopa’s: we’re wishing you and your loved ones a wonderful holiday season, however you celebrate! ❄️🎁

See you in January! 👋

notes.title: Kokopa's Atlas Demo is live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:

[previewyoutube=ZzwdEKjtBGo;full][/previewyoutube] (The title is in Spanish, but the video itself is in English! You'll even see me talking about the game!)

And as a neat extra, you can snag a discounted copy by backing at one of the Earlybird tiers! FYI, these limited time and limited quantity, so please be quick if you're interested! 🐤
